name: AVA Fade Spots Serum | Brightening & Dark Spot Care Serum | Hydrating Night Serum | 30ml
description:
Transform your nighttime skincare routine with AVA Fade Spots Serum, an advanced formula enriched with Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, Kojic Acid, Glutathione, and Glycolic Acid. Specially designed to improve the appearance of dark spots, uneven skin tone, and dullness, this lightweight serum helps promote smoother, brighter, and healthier-looking skin. Infused with Aloe Vera, Ferulic Acid, Matrixyl-3000, and Glycerin, the fast-absorbing formula deeply hydrates and nourishes the skin while supporting its natural glow. Suitable for regular nighttime use, this serum leaves your skin feeling refreshed and revitalized.

Enriched with Niacinamide, Alpha Arbutin, and Kojic Acid
